result.summary: Implemented lib/letflow/definitions/export_import.ex (Letflow.Definitions.ExportImport) exactly per lib/letflow/design/export_import.md: @export_schema_version "bpm/definition/v1", nested ExportDocument struct (7 fields per §4.1), export/2 (delegates to Definitions.get_by_id/2, copies name/version/description/graph verbatim, read-only), import/3 (imported_by param added per design §4.3 OQ-3 reasoning; I0 schema-version gate runs first and returns {:error, {:unknown_schema_version, actual}} before any tenant/DB touch; I1 builds create_attrs with no :id/:stage/:tenant_id/:status keys; I2 delegates unconditionally to Definitions.create/2 with the return passed through unchanged, no Graph module calls anywhere in this file). `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` exit 0: 'Compiling 1 file (.ex)\nGenerated letflow app'. `mix format --check-formatted lib/letflow/definitions/export_import.ex` exit 0 (silent, no diff) confirming my new file itself is correctly formatted; a full-repo `mix format --check-formatted` still exits 1, but diffing its output before vs. after adding this file (via git stash) showed the failure list is byte-identical -- all pre-existing issues in unrelated files (e.g. test/letflow/definitions_test.exs), none introduced by this change. Self-review: no direct Letflow.Definitions.Graph calls (grep confirmed), no unresolved `{:ok, _} =` match on external I/O, no SQL string interpolation (no direct DB access in this module), both export/2 and import/3 carry @doc, document.id never appears in the create_attrs map built by import/3 (grep confirmed only referenced in moduledoc/struct-field context).
